laws_and_bills.name: H.727 An act relating to sustainable data center deployment (Sustainable Data Centers Act)
laws_and_bills.what: Would have regulated data centers of 20 MW or more (quarterly water and energy reporting, decommissioning legislation by 2026-12-15). Passed House 2026-03-31 and Senate 26-3; vetoed by Gov. Scott; House vote to override failed 83-52 (veto sustained) on 2026-05-29.

laws_and_bills.name: S.205 AI data center moratorium
laws_and_bills.what: Temporary moratorium on siting and building AI data centers while the Public Utility Commission studies them; referred to Senate Finance 2026-01-06, no later action found (committee meetings through 2026-02-18); likely died when the session ended, not confirmed.

rate_cases.what: No data center tariff case found. Existing GMP Rate 70 serves C&I customers taking power from the transmission grid with peak demand over 10 MW (cited by DPS in H.727 testimony). GMP told the Senate it has sites that can add 50-200 MW.

incentives.name: None: no data-center-specific state tax incentive found
incentives.what: Vermont has no data center tax incentive in NCSL's 'Status of Data Center Tax Incentives, by State (2026)' table (adapted from Husch Blackwell's 50-state survey, last updated 2026-07-27; listed as N/A; table data: https://datawrapper.dwcdn.net/TQYDf/5/dataset.csv). Checked 32 V.S.A. 9741 (sales and use tax exemptions) on 2026-10-15: no data center exemption (only a general office machines/computers item).
